title: 1956 AHSME Problem 22
statement: Jones covered a distance of \(50\) miles on his first trip. On a later trip he traveled \(300\) miles while going three times as fast. His new time compared with the old time was:

solutions.text:
If the first speed was \(v,\) the old time was \(\frac{50}{v}.\) The later time was \[ \frac{300}{3v}=\frac{100}{v}=2\left(\frac{50}{v}\right). \] Thus the new time was twice the old time.

The correct answer is B.
hints: Write each travel time as distance divided by speed
If the old speed is \(v,\) compare \(\frac{50}{v}\) with \(\frac{300}{3v}\)
